verdict.rationale: Workflow Builder documents a no-code way to combine steps and triggers, but the only trigger type evidenced is a webhook trigger, which starts a workflow on demand from outside Slack rather than on a recurring schedule. AI 'daily recaps' are a built-in summary feature, not user-defined scheduled jobs. No evidence shows scheduled or recurring triggers, so a one-off or event-driven start cannot stand in for a recurring schedule.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
